title: Record an answer
lead: For an answer the guest gave by phone or in person. Fill in what you know: questions the guest’s page requires can wait, and anything left as it was stays as it was. The guest isn’t told unless you tick the box below.
guestRefused: Your role can’t see the guest list, so it can’t record an answer. The event’s owner or a coordinator can.
erased: This guest’s details were erased at their request, so no answer can be recorded for them.
askingUnknown: The invitation’s questions couldn’t be read, so only whether they’re coming can be recorded now. Reload the page to try again.

attendance.perVenue: Are they coming, at each place?
attendance.perVenueHelp: A place left unanswered keeps what it had.

question.requiredHelp: The guest’s page asks this of anyone coming; here it can wait. An answer once given can be changed, not removed.
question.signature: Only the guest can agree, through their own link.

notify.label: Tell the guest it was recorded
notify.help: Off by default: they gave the answer themselves, so a confirmation would surprise them.

errors.chooseVenue: Give an answer for one place at least.
errors.refused: This answer wasn’t accepted: the question may have changed. The page has been reloaded.

refused.erased: This guest’s details were erased at their request. The page has been reloaded.
refused.ticketVoid: Their ticket is no longer valid, so they can’t be recorded as coming.
refused.policyChanged: How guests answer changed since this page was opened. It has been reloaded: give the answer again.
refused.signature: Agreeing to a statement needs the guest’s own link.
refused.questionRefused: One answer wasn’t accepted: the question may have changed. The page has been reloaded.
refused.fieldRefused: The invitation no longer asks one of these questions this way. The page has been reloaded.
refused.venueRefused: One of these places is no longer shown to guests. The page has been reloaded.
refused.modeChanged: How guests answer changed since this page was opened. It has been reloaded: give the answer again.
refused.gone: This guest is no longer on the list.
refused.forbidden: Your role on this event can’t record answers. Its owner or a coordinator can.
refused.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
refused.noAnswer: No answer came. Check the guest list to see whether it was recorded, then try again.
